Measure your screen.

Find dimensions. Measure gaps. Get the details right.

Download for Mac Free & open source · macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon & Intel

Find dimensions ⇧⌘F

Hover between elements to see horizontal and vertical distances.

Measure an area ⇧⌘M

Draw an exact rectangle. Move it, resize it, or nudge it one pixel at a time.

Keep the details Space

Pin measurements while you work. Press Return to copy dimensions, or Shift-Return for CSS.

Getting started

Open the DMG and drag Schnaps into Applications. For Find Dimensions, allow Screen Recording in Schnaps → Settings → Permissions. Then press ⇧⌘F. Manual area measurement works without this permission.

Privacy and updates

Screen snapshots stay in memory on your Mac and are discarded when you close the overlay. The app has no analytics or accounts. This website uses cookie-free Cloudflare Web Analytics for visits, page views, and referrers. Download starts are counted in aggregate without cookies or visitor identifiers. Signed app updates are available through Sparkle.

Retina and multiple displays

Choose screen points or physical display pixels. Each display uses its own scale, and each measurement stays within one display.

Schnaps

A small, native Mac app for the details. Find dimensions, measure gaps, and copy precise measurements.

Written in Swift. Free and open source.
